title: My Dad Ordered the Same Gross Pizza Every Birthday. After He Passed, It Still Came.
hook: After my dad passed… his birthday pizza still showed up
story: Every year on my birthday, my dad ordered the same terrible pizza. Pineapple, jalapeño, and extra olives. I hated it. He knew I hated it. That was the joke. When I was nineteen, my dad passed away in March. My birthday was in June, and I wasn't planning on celebrating at all. At 7 p.m., there was a knock on the door. The delivery driver was holding a pineapple, jalapeño, extra olive pizza. I told him he had the wrong house. He checked his phone and said, "No, it's a standing order. Paid in advance. It says… ten more years." On the box, someone at the shop had copied the order notes in marker, word for word. "Happy birthday, kid. I know you hate it. Eat one slice anyway, for me." I ate the whole thing, crying on the porch. That was nine birthdays ago. Next year is the last pizza. So yesterday, I called the shop… and ordered ten more years. For my son.
